subject: Toy Cars on Thursday the 5th of March
author: ZombieTron
body:
As reported on the CGN:

The Toys Are Back in Town
The Toys Pack will be released on console this Thursday!

Keep an eye on the Twitter tab for up-to-the-minute info on when your version will be out.

We'll be back with all the information on all 9 mini vehicles and how to get them on Thursday morning.

 
If you can't wait until then for incredible new Burnout Paradise vehicles, there's plenty to keep you going with the recent release of Legendary Cars.

The Legendary Cars Pack is available now from our in-game Burnout store as well as your console stores.

subject: I can't wait
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: They will probably release the first pack of toy cars, then the boost specials, then the other toy cars pack, to mix it up.  Maybe one of the packs will be released Friday for by birthday! (I know it's not likely, but I can hope)
